name: CtrlS Bhopal DC1 (Badwai IT Park)
notes: Greenfield AI-ready data centre, Rs 500 crore (~$59m), 5-acre parcel at Badwai IT Park, Bhopal. Virtual groundbreaking by CM Mohan Yadav at Tech Growth Conclave 2025 (27 Apr 2025). Capacity/timeline not disclosed. DCD/trade press evidence.

name: Madhya Pradesh State Data Centre (SDC), Bhopal
notes: State-level e-governance data centre in Bhopal, operated under MPSEDC; 2026 tender for HCI servers/virtualization at MP State Data Centre confirms ongoing operation. Government SDC, not commercial colo.

name: MPSEDC-Submer 1GW AI-ready data centre MoU
notes: State-level MoU signed at MP Business Forum, Barcelona (Jul 2025) between MPSEDC and Submer Technologies for a 1GW AI-ready data centre; no site/investor/operator/timeline disclosed. District assignment (Bhopal) inferred from MPSEDC base; treat as policy ambition until site named. Capacity is the state target, not a committed project figure.

name: RackBank Pithampur facility
notes: RackBank's own site lists Pithampur among locations ('operates and expands across strategic locations such as Raipur, Pithampur, Navi Mumbai, and Indore'). Pithampur industrial area lies in Dhar district. No facility detail, capacity, or news corroboration found; status unverified.

name: RackBank 80MW AI Data Centre (Indore)
notes: India's first purpose-built AI data centre near Indore; 80MW in four 20MW phases, 60,000 GPU capacity at full build-out, liquid immersion cooling (Varuna), PUE 1.1-1.3. Foundation stone laid 23 Oct 2024 by CM Mohan Yadav; DCD reported go-live target Q4 2024, full capacity Q3 2025. Marked construction (started) pending verified operational status; 80MW is planned full build-out. One of five MP projects under state DC investment policy incentives.

name: RackBank Indore legacy colocation facility (Old Palasia)
notes: RackBank's original Tier-III colocation/data centre in Indore (Old Palasia) operational since ~2013; PeeringDB facility 'Rackbank DC Central India' (Indore, MP 452016). Own-site/PeeringDB evidence of existence; capacity not published.

name: Dinclix GroundWorks Indore
notes: Referenced in DCD (citing DataCenterMap) as the only other operator in the Indore region alongside RackBank. C-grade aggregator lead; no independent facility details found.

name: New Indore IT Park with data centre component (MPIDC)
notes: Upcoming IT park in Indore (~1.1 lakh sq m) to house an incubation centre and a data centre; press report Mar 2026. Park-level plan with DC component; no operator/capacity announced.
